payload.body: Async-ified FrickSearchAdapter (upsert/delete/query -> Promise) + shipped createPgFtsSearchAdapter (tsvector/GIN, @@ plainto_tsquery, ts_rank, jsonb field filters). Rippled the now-async search-notify through store write paths + search route + erase. 3/3 PG conformance; SQLite 781 green; test:pg widened. This is the first of the SQLite-bound-subsystem ports the full-server-on-PG keystone needs (devtools/platform-events next).
